notes: NP_11 s6's faucet/sink audit as the sim runs it (PAC-097): 'Faucet/sink audit runs per milestone (NP_13 s6): target - a story-pace player affords 70% of desired sinks; completionists find Prestige/Beans the long tails.' The faucet is a story-pace playthrough to Arc 3's start, paid by the sim's own reward paths with the results given: NP_12 s4's Arc 1 (24 episodes, NP_12 s8) and Arc 2 (its beats loose by intent - Arc 1's length here), one story dual an episode at NP_02 s5's cadence (one per 60-90 min of critical path), NP_02 s5's 45-minute session shape between (4-6 scraps, 1-2 spars, 1 training slot), the gym at the tiers the story opens. A segment's own XP (its hits, counters, flashes and drops) is measured from played fights, the obsolescence audit's builds against its endgame. The sinks a story-pace player wants by Arc 3 are priced from the live tables: the dressed squad each built as the obsolescence audit builds (its ledger's spend), the five facility tracks to T3, a Forge. The verdict names each currency that misses: its share against the target, its session pay against NP_11 s6's typical/session, the protagonist's level against NP_11 s2's ~35 by Arc 3, and the obsolescence audit's budget against what the faucet pays. The episode split, the results, the session counts, the band and the squad are first drafts; the economy lane's to set.

target.text: NP_11 s6: a story-pace player affords 70% of desired sinks (the band either side is editorial: under it the player is starved of choices, over it the sinks stop being choices)

pace.text: NP_02 s5: 'one dual per 60-90 min of critical path' (75), 'Session shape target (45-min session): 1 story beat + 4-6 scraps + 1-2 spars + 1 training slot' (the midpoints; its story beat and recruitment step - read as a quest step, NP_02 s4 - pay through story_mark since PAC-098); optional duals are not a story-pace player's; since PAC-099 the bench's roles pay through the sim's own paths (the scout when the day turns, the training partner in the slot, the cornerman-in-training at a dual's end); since PAC-101 each phase's scraps are fought in its districts in turn, their rep and its milestones on the ledger - Ep1's Millbrook Secondary and community centre (NP_12A), the circuit's Rink District (the bridge-the-town questline) and harbour (the MacIsaac quest), Arc 2's Hill (the Whitecloud roadwork) and downtown strip (the districts per phase are editorial)

results.text: a story-pace player wins nine scraps in ten and seven spars in ten; a won dual carries three segments in five, a lost one two; the minigames graded at the median; the captain fights the overworld's scraps and spars and opens every dual (R1)

bench.text: PAC-099: NP_08 s1's roles on a story-pace bench - the story's own squad is dressed whole, so the bench is NP_08 s2.4's open mat ('the filler roster channel for players who want bodies for training roles'): three of the machine's generics signed on the circuit's first open-mat day (day 7, two days into the circuit; seated at the phase's start), from what the club phase's pulls threw off (tier 1 by its flags), one to each role and kept to Arc 3. The districts are editorial

pace.level_text: NP_11 s2: 'a story-pace player hits ~35 by Arc 3 start' (the band either side is editorial)
